generated.details: The clear glass carafe has a broad flat-bottomed body, narrowing neck and open pouring lip, with a level water surface inside.
Across the edge at far left, the pulled-back charcoal office chair has a padded fabric seat and back joined to a swivel pedestal and five-spoke caster base; crop it at frame left, facing the screen.
Background glass partitions have continuous panes held by slim metal uprights.
Slate blue painted-wood sound-diffusion blocks cover a broad upper-center and upper-right area of the far wall, their rectangular blocks projecting at varied depths from a shared backing.
